notes:
Access: direct HTTP fetch worked throughout; robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow. Discovery: /sitemap_collections_1.xml plus full homepage nav/footer link extraction and site search (/search?q=clearance, non-discriminating, returned a generic 1000-item cap, treated as supporting evidence only). The site's persistent top utility bar (present sitewide, alongside Furniture/Lighting/Home Decor/etc.) links to /collections/outlet ('Outlet'), which is this site's own genuine Clearance-taxonomy term (H1 'Outlet', clean breadcrumb, real 1226-product PLP with pagination). Via the collections sitemap, found 6 category-specific children following the same 'X Outlet' naming: furniture-outlet (89), lighting-outlet (64), flowers-orchids-outlet (320), trees-outlet (34), mirrors-outlet (4), and twigs-leafy-outlet (0 products - dropped, empty listing). These are not directly hyperlinked from the /collections/outlet page itself (which is a flat product grid, no category filter links found in its facet markup) but are real, live, indexed PLPs discoverable via the site's own sitemap, mirroring the exact same category split used elsewhere on the site (e.g. furniture/lighting/home-decor top categories) - included as genuine site-defined children of Outlet/Clearance. CRITICAL SALE-VS-CLEARANCE CHECK: the site separately runs a large, clearly promotional 'Sale' system that was NOT included here: /collections/sale (title 'Shop Luxury Furniture Sale Online | Up To 50% Off', 6462 products - essentially the whole catalog under a temporary discount banner), /collections/fall-sale (nav/hero banner reads 'FALL SALE - UP TO 75% OFF EVERYTHING', clearly a time-boxed seasonal promo, linked in main nav as 'Fall Sale'), plus ~20 other per-category '-sale' collections found in the sitemap (home-decor-sale, lighting-sale, marble-decor-sale, paintings-wall-art-sale, bedlinen-sale, furniture-sale, mirrors-sale, rugs-carpets-sale, tableware-sale, christmas-sale, flowers-orchids-sale, plants-succulents-sale, trees-sale, artificial-flowers-sale, orchids-sale, ramadan-sale, spring-sale, summer-sale, white-november-sale-50-off-storewide). These all use generic 'Sale'/percent-off/seasonal-campaign wording (several tied to specific calendar events: Ramadan, spring, summer, fall, a November promo) with no clearance/outlet/final/end-of-line language anywhere on the pages checked - a textbook temporary-promotion pattern, not a permanent-markdown taxonomy, so per the brief's Sale-vs-Clearance test these were excluded, not flagged as ambiguous (the distinction here was clear-cut: the site runs the two systems, Sale and Outlet, side by side and consistently). No Arabic-specific clearance term was found; the /ar/ locale mirrors the same Shopify catalog via translated strings.

[POLICY UPDATE 2026-09-11] Removed 6 Outlet-classified row(s) per corrected policy: Outlet is not Clearance.
